{{Quote|That's why I killed her, you know. Your "Fe Sun". Zeltrons are seen as ''manipulative''. Not as someone to be respected. Not in the worlds I work in. But killing a Jedi? Ah, now ''that'' makes you ''dangerous''.|Lyshaa to Shaak Ti during the Battle of Brentaal IV|<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />}}
'''Lyshaa''' was a renowned [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] murderer who [[Death/Legends|killed]] her own family and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Fe Sun]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. [[Prisoner/Legends|Imprisoned]] for her crimes on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], she participated in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] breakout during a [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the world during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Ti, fighting with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the battle, came across the Zeltron and agreed to let her free on the condition the Republic's mission was completed.

The murderer used her Zeltron powers to seduce planetary leader and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Shogar Tok]] in his [[Shogar Tok's fortress|fortress]], before betraying Ti by shooting her. With a place at the leader's side, Lyshaa exposed her former allies, but the Jedi Master was not dead as she thought she was. Ti fought the two, killing Tok and leading Lyshaa to flee. Rather than be captured once more and assuming the Jedi planned on killing her, Lyshaa chose suicide in the fortress's [[lightstorm chamber]].

==Biography==
===Death abound===
{{Quote|She's the one who put me in prison.''"<br />"''You killed one of my former Padawans.|Lyshaa and Shaak Ti|<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />}}
[[File:Brentaal.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Lyshaa, Sagoro Autem, and Ryyk broke out of the Brentaal IV prison.]]
Lyshaa was a renowned<ref name="FF113" /> [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]]<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal<ref name="FF113" /> and murderer<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|shaakti|Ti, Shaak}}</ref> who [[Death/Legends|killed]] her own family in a fit of rage.<ref name="CSWE" /> She also murdered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Fe Sun]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> The Zeltron killed her in an effort to gain respect among her criminal peers,<ref name="CSWE" /> but she was hunted down by Ti and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] on<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] before she had time to enjoy any perks.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> Lyshaa was also found guilty of the murder of her family as well.<ref name="CSWE" /> 

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after the murder of Sun,<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ShaakDate" /> the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], had broken out. A [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|battle]] occurred on Brentaal IV, during which Lyshaa and fellow prisoners&mdash;the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Ryyk (Wookiee)|Ryyk]] and former [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] [[Sagoro Autem]]&mdash;made a jailbreak, though they met resistance from local rebels. Ti, who was fighting alongside the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], entered the [[Brentaal IV prison|prison]] they were kept in to rally her troops. While in battle against the rebels, Autem told Lyshaa to keep Ryyk, who nearly decapitated<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> the man,<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|sagoroautem|Autem, Sagoro}}</ref> away from him. Lyshaa responded back that the Wookiee was simply acting in defense to her, to which the Wookiee growled back. Coming across the prisoners, Ti and her [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] fought back against the rebels alongside them.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

===Near-death experience===
{{Quote|You want me dead! I killed your precious Padawan, and you intend to kill me here!''"</br>"''Had I simply wanted revenge for Fe Sun, I would have killed you when I first caught you and not turned you over for imprisonment.|Lyshaa confronts Shaak Ti|<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />}}
After the fighting ended, Lyshaa and Ti confronted each other before the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] turned her attention to Ryyk. As Ti calmed the Wookiee, Lyshaa explained his story to her. Shortly thereafter, Ti freed the undercover Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who joined up with Ti. The Togruta volunteered for the prisoners to join her, offering them freedom after Lyshaa suggested it to make the deal better for them. The group ventured into the prison sewers to infiltrate Separatist<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> planetary leader<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Shogar Tok|Shogar Tok's]] [[Shogar Tok's fortress|fortress]].<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> While moving through the sewers, the Zeltron held a brief talk with Autem, revealing her distrust of Ti. The prisoner asked her why she offered the deal, to which she responded that she never thought the Jedi would take it. The group came across a [[Scrange/Legends|scrange]] that killed Ryyk, and after pushing on, the group separated; Ti and Lyshaa would capture Tok, Vos and Autem would disable the fortress's tower [[Laser cannon/Legends|cannons]], and a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Brentaal IV)|clone trooper]] would attack the shield generator.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

[[File:LyshaaShaakTi-JST.png|thumb|left|400px|Shaak Ti saved Lyshaa's life in the lightstorm chamber.]]
While with Ti, Lyshaa ended up in a [[lightstorm chamber]], an automated protection device in the fortress. The Zeltron cleared the area before asking the Jedi where the Togruta planned to kill her. Ti told the murderer not to move, though she did not listen, and the Jedi had to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to save her from the many [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] that appeared. Ti threw Lyshaa clear of them and made her way through the lasers, after which she found their [[Comlink/Legends|communicator]] smoking and inoperable. The Zeltron accused Ti of using her to test the room, which led to an intense, one-way argument over the Jedi supposedly wanting her dead. Enraged, Lyshaa struck Ti across the face, to which the Togruta combated by pushing her to the floor. Ti explained that she needed her alive to make use of her ability to project emotions and control others. Lyshaa told Ti that that view of Zeltrons was why she killed her Padawan and questioned if she was really going to set her free. The Togruta swore that she would on the condition that the mission was completed.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

===Even more death===
{{Quote|You never understood, Lyshaa. I never sought revenge&mdash;|Shaak Ti after Lyshaa's death|<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />}}
[[File:LyshaaDeath-JST.png|thumb|right|350px|Lyshaa chose death in the lightstorm chamber.]]
Lyshaa made her way to Tok's private chambers, where she seduced him using her ability. Ti entered and took control of the situation, trying to convince the planetary leader to stand his troopers down and accept the Republic.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> Taking the earliest opportunity for betrayal,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Lyshaa decided to kill the Jedi and shot her in the chest, seemingly ending her life. As Tok regained control of himself, the Zeltron explained that the Jedi was using [[Mind trick/Legends|mind-control powers]] and had allies disrupting his shield and weapons, before pledging her allegiance to him. After Tok dealt with Lyshaa's former allies, he asked how he could show his gratitude to her, to which she asked for a throne next to his. As that occurred, Ti regained consciousness and fought the two, killing Tok and making Lyshaa flee.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

Catching up with the murderer in the lightstorm chamber, Ti revoked the two's old agreement but offered her life. Thinking Ti just planned to kill her, Lyshaa chose to take her own life by tripping the defenses in the chamber. As her body lay smoking on the ground, the Jedi remarked that the murderer never understood that she did not want revenge.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, in [[36 ABY]], Lyshaa, and her betrayal of Ti, were chronicled in a [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|historical document]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You don't get to do it! You don't get your ''revenge!''|Lyshaa chooses to kill herself out of a misunderstanding of Shaak Ti's motives|<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />}}
An unusually violent and malign Zeltron,<ref name="FF113" /> Lyshaa's personality was characterized by untrustworthiness and vindictiveness.<ref name="FF116">{{FactFile|116|SHA 7-8|Shaak Ti}}</ref> Though she was considered to be one of the most notorious of her [[Species/Legends|species]] at her [[Time/Legends|time]], she did not reflect an accurate depiction of Zeltrons.<ref name="FF113" /> In one instance, Lyshaa killed her family in a fit of rage and years after the fact,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|269|Lyshaa}}</ref> claimed that she killed Fe Sun for no other reason than to be seen as dangerous in the worlds she worked in where her species was seen as manipulative.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

[[File:Lyshaa_rage.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Lyshaa was a malign individual who did not represent Zeltrons as a whole.]]
The Zeltron did not grasp why the death of Ryyk's family held importance to him, as she had killed hers. Lyshaa also taunted Shaak Ti by asking her if she had trained any new Padawans, and that she would love to cook them once freed from imprisonment.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> Lyshaa held the incorrect belief that the Jedi planned to kill her, taking revenge for the death of Fe Sun. The Zeltron struck Ti<ref name="FF116" /> in a fit of rage<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> on one occasion and decided to betray the Togruta by killing her<ref name="FF116" /> and joining Shogar Tok.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> Even after Ti willed to forgive Lyshaa and offered her life, the Zeltron committed suicide,<ref name="FF116" /> out of an unwillingness to be captured<ref name="FF113" /> and concluding that Ti wanted revenge.<ref name="FF116" />

The young<ref name="ShaakTiInCommand">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/comics/news20030415.html|text=Shaak Ti in Command}}</ref> Zeltron had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> characteristic of her species,<ref name="FF113" /> purple colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and [[Hair/Legends|hair]] colored purple as well. A scar cut through her left eyebrow and her hair was tied in many braids.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Zeltrons can project emotions and control others. I have need of that. You will use those abilities on Tok so we can end this situation bloodlessly. I need you alive|Shaak Ti, to Lyshaa|<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />}}
Lyshaa possessed the Zeltron ability to project emotions onto others and control them,<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> which she used to lull Tok into her confidence.<ref name="FF116" /> The criminal proved the power to be dangerous in her hands,<ref name="FF113" /> just as she was.<ref name="ShaakTiInCommand" />

==Equipment==
While imprisoned on Brentaal IV, Lyshaa wore a yellow [[Clothing/Legends|top]], blue pants, and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. Accompanying the outfit were pairs of silver armbands and [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]] and a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with a [[Holster/Legends|holster]].  Light colored wrappings held her braids in place. During the prisoner revolt, she defended herself with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and after allying with Shogar Tok, took up dual [[Sword/Legends|swords]] to attack Ti.<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Making matters near unbearable, however, is the fact that one of the members of her improvised strike team is a Zeltron who played a role in the death of one of her former Padawans.|Daniel Wallace mentions Lyshaa before her first appearance|<ref name="Insider67" />}}
Lyshaa was first shown in both the [[Daniel Wallace]] written [[Comics Link]] department of the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|Comics Link}}<!-- Love Shaak: A Jedi of a Different Color --></ref> and in the [[StarWars.com]] article "Shaak Ti in Command," both published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref><ref name="ShaakTiInCommand" /> The character, left unnamed in the ''Insider'' article, was identified in the Dramatis Personnae section of the web article.<ref name="ShaakTiInCommand" /> Lyshaa then first appeared in ''[[Jedi: Shaak Ti]]'', the second issue in the [[Star Wars: Jedi (one-shots)|''Star Wars: Jedi'' one-shots]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" /> and published on [[May 14]], 2003 by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-375/Star-Wars-Jedi----Shaak-Ti|text=STAR WARS: JEDI -- SHAAK TI}}</ref>
